summary: New shared guide split out of the old agentic-upgrade doc. It holds the duplicate-PR preflight and the commit and delivery steps used by all three upgrade policies. It adds Future Defaults duplicate checks, per-default commit grouping, and an ask-to-open-PR step when permission is missing. next-upgrade.ts bundles this file and tells the agent to follow it first, so it directly steers what the agent commits and publishes.
headline: Shared agent guide for duplicate checks and commit/PR delivery
reason: Draft docs, but the bundled text is the agent's instructions and sets its commit, PR and stop behavior, so wording changes alter runtime behavior.
risk_signals: agent instructions control commits and PR publishing
focus: Delivery rules still match the old step 5 for different-major upgrades (one commit per crossed major)
New Future Defaults commit grouping and the ask-to-open-PR step when permission is missing
Duplicate-check markers and stop conditions are unchanged from the old guide
